import unreal, json, hashlib
paths=['/Game/Characters/Heroes/Mannequin/Animations/ABP_Mannequin_Base','/Game/Characters/Heroes/Mannequin/Animations/LinkedLayers/ABP_ItemAnimLayersBase']
graphs=['AnimGraph','BlueprintThreadSafeUpdateAnimation','UpdateBlendWeightData','UpdateSkelControlData','SetLeftHandPoseOverrideWeight','FullBody_SkeletalControls','FullBodyAdditives','LeftHandPose_OverrideState']
for p in paths:
 print('ASSET|'+p)
 names=[g.graph_name for g in unreal.AnimGraphService.list_graphs(p)]
 for gn in graphs:
  if gn not in names: continue
  rows=[]
  for n in unreal.BlueprintService.get_nodes_in_graph(p,gn):
   pins=[]
   for pin in unreal.BlueprintService.get_node_pins(p,gn,n.node_id): pins.append((pin.pin_name,pin.pin_type,pin.is_input,pin.is_connected,pin.default_value))
   rows.append((n.pos_x,n.pos_y,n.node_type,n.node_title,sorted(pins)))
  blob=json.dumps(sorted(rows),ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True)
  print('HASH|{}|{}|{}|{}'.format(gn,len(rows),hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest(),len(blob)))
